t: This is TLDR News, a British independent news outlet founded in 2017. It publishes mostly on YouTube and Nebula, and most of its video reports focus on political issues in the United Kingdom and abroad. The name stands for 'too long; didn't read'. It was founded by Jack Kelly, a British journalist and editor born in 1996. Kelly matters here because he started the outlet, and its short, explanatory approach to news began with him. So this is less a building to look at than a newsroom whose work lives online.
